acceptance_signals: The English and Simplified Chinese pages tell the same five-act project story in natural first-person language, with Chinese independently written rather than translated sentence by sentence.
The default story supports an approximately two-minute spoken route with clean cut points and a five-to-seven-minute screen-share expansion.
The turning point uses the human-confirmed repeated benefit-to-core-requirement mismatch and does not invent a single dramatic discovery event.

The page distinguishes human-originated decisions, jointly formed decisions, Agent-proposed repairs approved by the human, and observed system behavior without overstating personal invention or mechanical enforcement.

The main story uses at most one architecture diagram and three substantial proof points, and contains no SHA-256 values, evidence taxonomy legend, large command block, or full internal Kernel and Adapter taxonomy.

Airbnb is presented as one observed live Agent and human workflow, artifact replay as one bounded Windows engineering-depth case, and Taxi as product-learning context rather than broad adoption proof.
The page states that task-level verification cannot decide whether the right product is being built and does not claim automated product-drift detection.
Stable release and development-source capabilities remain visibly distinct, and unsupported adoption, security, portability, and repeated-reliability claims are absent.

Both pages use local assets only, restrictive CSP, semantic HTML, visible keyboard focus, reciprocal language navigation, working evidence links, and responsive layouts without narrow-screen overflow.
The homepage receives one minimal discoverability link; no README, Portfolio, Interview Guide, runtime, release, ADR, or governance-framework restructuring occurs.
Focused interview and product-site tests, task and repository governance, exact scope validation, task JSON parsing, and git diff checks pass.

All pre-existing changed content is preserved outside the exact included paths; pre-existing files under the broad task and baseline prefixes are preservation-only, and existing STATUS and dated-log content is preserved except for bounded updates.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-bc5d4f62f7cd45689d9978bffa07a1a4 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Create one minimal English and Simplified Chinese public interview-story surface for AgentGov. The story must use the human-confirmed first-person account of gradual product and architecture drift, the rapid return to the development-time governance MVP, and evidence-bounded Airbnb and artifact-replay proof points. Add one minimal homepage entry and focused documentation tests. Do not modify the existing Interview Guide in this slice.

items: First-person wording could overstate motivations or authorship beyond the human-confirmed account.
The public page could regress into a governance dashboard or duplicate the existing Interview Guide.
Airbnb or artifact-replay wording could overstate general adoption, independent assurance, or mechanical enforcement.
Stable and development-source behavior could be mixed in one product claim.
Broad existing task and baseline prefixes contain pre-existing work that must remain byte-identical except for the new task and baseline.
STATUS.md and the dated log already contain pre-existing work that must be preserved.
Browser rendering and actual spoken duration require separate observed validation.
Reviewed assumption: The human is AgentGov's primary and sole product and engineering owner.
Reviewed assumption: The human has long used short-term benefit, long-term benefit, and next-stage connection reviews after features.
Reviewed assumption: The human first verified accumulated drift, then rapidly returned development to the core MVP before adding detail features.
Reviewed assumption: The confirmed decision-attribution list is the source for personal, joint, and Agent-proposed architecture wording.
Reviewed assumption: The existing site visual system and local assets are sufficient; no generated imagery or client-side application state is needed.
Reviewed unknown: Actual two-minute speaking duration remains unknown until the human rehearses the implemented route.
Reviewed unknown: Cross-browser and touch behavior remain unknown until browser QA.
Reviewed unknown: The Interview Guide integration remains a separate Slice 2 task and is not authorized here.
